CustomField.description: For a PayPal subscription's first payment: the mode, currency, amount and interval its billing plan charges (canonical model R-PAY7). Payments reuses the plan of the newest payment with the same key. Written by Payments only.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: What the PayPal billing plan charges: mode, currency, amount and interval. Payers who give the same amount on the same schedule share one plan.
CustomField.label: Plan Key
